---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the specific use case or scenario where this feature would be valuable.

**Example:**
"I use iTerm2 instead of Terminal.app, and would like the app to support it so I can get auto-approval without switching terminals."

## Platform

Which platform(s) does this feature apply to?
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Both

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical (blocking my usage)
- [ ] High (would significantly improve my experience)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (minor convenience)

## Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] I'd be willing to implement this feature myself (with guidance)
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I can only report the need

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

Link to any related issues or discussions:
